headline: Tata Communications provides an update on its intra-group restructuring to the stock exchange

summary: Tata Communications Limited has officially notified the stock exchanges regarding an update on its ongoing intra-group restructuring process. headline: Tata Communications plans Rs 4,350 crore investment for a 10,000-km AI data centre network
hook: Massive AI infrastructure bet by Tata Group
summary: Tata Communications will invest ₹4,350 crore to build a 10,000-kilometre AI-ready data centre network across India. The first phase will connect hubs in Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, and Chennai, while subsequent phases will extend connectivity to Vizag, Bhubaneswar, Jamnagar, and GIFT City. This capital expenditure aims to capture surging enterprise demand for artificial intelligence and cloud infrastructure. Indian retail investors tracking telecom and digital infrastructure will see this as a major capacity expansion play.
whats_next: Progress updates on the first phase deployment across Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad and Chennai
why_it_matters: Capex push strengthens Tata's position in the AI data infrastructure race
winners_losers: Tata Communications gains / legacy telecom providers challenged
